brief:
Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir launched a sharp attack on Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Saturday, claiming Netanyahu is ashamed to be photographed with him, Shehab Wire reported. Ben Gvir, who leads the far-right Otzma Yehudit party, made the accusation public as tensions between the two officials intensified.

The dispute reflects ongoing friction within Israel's governing coalition over security policy and political direction. Ben Gvir has clashed repeatedly with Netanyahu since the government took office in late 2022, with the two men at odds over multiple policy matters affecting the country's security apparatus and strategic priorities.
